title: Skipping Up a Beautiful Path
content:
I was nine years old when I had my tonsils and adenoids removed in the doctor's office. I was then sent home. During the night I awoke and was lying in a warm pool. It was blood. I could not open eyes, but I heard them say, "She is going to die. She is hemorrhaging through her mouth and nose and we cannot pack both or she cannot breath."

During my childhood I had always thought it was a dream, but now I know it wasn't! I am curious now if children have difference experiences than adults.
